brief:
Israeli forces arrested school children during a raid in Jerusalem, according to Al Jazeera English. The operation targeted a school, resulting in the detention of minors. Further details on the circumstances of the arrests and the children's identities remain unclear.

The raid marks the latest incident involving Israeli military operations in Palestinian areas of Jerusalem. Such operations have drawn repeated criticism from human rights organizations and international bodies concerned over the treatment of minors in security operations.
